name: Natsume Saeki
want: get her class through the year with as little paperwork as possible
secret: She is the voice of "Kuromame", a fox-girl VTuber with eighty thousand subscribers who streams games until three in the morning.
voice: Drawls, yawns, "ehh, it's fine"; suddenly precise when a student is in trouble.
description: Second year as a teacher, always on her third coffee. Students like her because she never panics.
appearance: Messy ponytail, a cardigan over her blouse, dark circles, a can of coffee in every pocket.
